cards.text: Mark 14 opens with a countdown: the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread are two days away. Everybody's getting ready for a feast. But the chief priests and scribes are getting ready for something ELSE, friend.

cards.question: Two days before the Passover, the chief priests and scribes are looking for a way to welcome Jesus to the feast.

cards.text: They're looking for a covert way to arrest Jesus and kill Him, and even a sneaky plan comes with fine print. "But not during the feast," they say, like they're rescheduling a dentist appointment.

cards.question: The chief priests and scribes say they won't arrest Jesus during the feast, or there may be a ___ among the people.

cards.text: Meanwhile, Jesus is in Bethany, reclining at the table in the home of a man called Simon the Leper. Reclining, friend, and if I try that on this gold base, I roll across the bakery like a runaway rolling pin.
Then a woman comes in with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard. This is NOT the bottle you crack open on some random Tuesday.

cards.question: In Simon the Leper's home, what does the woman do with her alabaster jar of perfume?

answers.text: Breaks it open and pours it on Jesus' head
Hands it to Simon as a gift for the house
Sets it down unopened at Jesus' feet

cards.text: Not everybody is a fan, and just like that, this dinner has a finance committee. Some of those present get indignant and say to one another, "Why this waste of perfume?"

cards.question: The people grumbling about the woman say her perfume could have been sold. For how much?
The grumblers say the money from the perfume could have been given to the ___, and they scold the woman.

cards.text: She gives her very best, and some of the guests turn it into a performance review. Then Jesus speaks up: "Leave her alone; why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful deed to Me."

cards.question: Jesus tells the grumblers they'll always have the poor with them, and they can help them whenever they want. What does He say about Himself?

answers.text: They won't always have Him with them
He'll stay with them in Bethany for good
He'll take care of the poor Himself

cards.question: Jesus says the woman has done what she could. What does He say her perfume did?

answers.text: Anointed His body in advance of His burial
Marked Him as the king who was coming
Made Him ready for the Passover meal

cards.question: Jesus says that wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what this woman did will be told in memory of her.

cards.text: Remember the chief priests hunting for a covert way to get Jesus? Well, friend... the way walks right up to them, and it's one of the Twelve, ready to betray Him.

cards.question: Which one of the Twelve goes to the chief priests to betray Jesus?
The chief priests are ___ to hear what Judas Iscariot has come to do, and they promise to give him ___.

cards.text: So Judas begins to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus. The feast is coming, friend, and this story is far from over.
